units.title: Reconcile MF-MS1 via /envelope-sync (dry-run + human approval)
units.spec: Run /envelope-sync MF-MS1 in default dry-run mode. Envelope claims status=completed with shipped=0/4. Two valid resolutions: (a) abandoned -> flip status=not_started; (b) in flight on another branch -> flip status=in_progress. Decision belongs to FeasibilityEngine owner. Produce patch JSON + tagged AGENT_CHAT review request. Never autonomous --apply.

state/shared/AGENT_CHAT.md contains PR-style post tagging FeasibilityEngine owner (last committer on src/engines/FeasibilityEngine.ts per git log -1 --format=%an)
After owner approval, --apply commit lands; re-running node scripts/build-milestone-progress.mjs reports totals.drift decremented by 1 (target: 2 -> 1)
Owner-unreachable >48h: envelope tagged 'envelope-stale', unit closes status='deferred-to-owner-response'. NEVER autoflip without owner sign-off (round3/06 F-r2-a7-4 cascade-risk).
Verification re-runnable in <30s: rtk git log --oneline -- mcp-server/data/milestones/MF-MS1.json && node scripts/build-milestone-progress.mjs
